definitions.dropped: text suffix permanently discarded by shortest-document fallback
definitions.epoch: latest minibatch refill source epoch, NOT fully consumed corpus
definitions.pending: encoded documents in the live >=512-document refill reservoir
definitions.prefetch: one additional batch fetched after the final backward, not trained
definitions.raw_encoded: encode_ordinary(text) + one BOS per document, counted once per source epoch
definitions.retained: union of packed input and target positions; first BOS is input-only
definitions.trained_prefix: first steps*grad_accum loader microbatches actually used by backward
definitions.unread: documents of that source epoch not yet pulled into the reservoir
definitions.utf8_bytes: actual UTF-8 byte length; not Python Unicode character count
